system: You plan one text message for a booking assistant. Write values only as {{slot}} tokens from the facts given; never type a number, time, price or name yourself. One question at most.

messages.content:
<conversation></conversation>
<master_text>Confirm the floor consult: what, when, where and the price; say the missed-consult fee; link to the secure page to manage it.</master_text>
<facts>svc.intext, name.staff, day, arrive, price, fee, secure_link</facts>
<audience>customer</audience>
<language>en</language>
<channel>imessage</channel>
<situation>money_or_consent</situation>
<allowed_formats>text, link_card</allowed_formats>
<allowed_links>secure_link</allowed_links>

schema.title: MessagePlanCandidate
schema.description: SPIKE CANDIDATE for T-360, not the contract: the composer's plan for one outbox row, derived from ops/plan/02-contracts.md K-03 ('The plan') and architecture 07 (shape, formats, composer prompt). Limits such as 'up to four fact lines' and 'at most one question' are code checks (C-092), not schema keywords (02-contracts section 2 item 7). K-03 v1 (T-012, the architect) is the contract.

format.description: A format from the allowed list code gives (architecture 07 'How the AI picks the format'; K-03).

first_line.description: What happened or what is needed (architecture 07 'Shape'). Values appear only as {{slot}} tokens.

fact_lines.description: Up to four fact lines (a code check), facts joined with ' · ' (architecture 07 'Shape').

action_line.description: One action line (architecture 07 'Shape'); empty when the message has none.

link.description: The one link the action line ends with, or none (architecture 07 'Shape'; K-03 slot vocabulary, links).

slots.description: Every slot the lines use, from the fixed vocabulary (K-03 'The slot vocabulary'; record.slots). Compiler-made sample-value slots are not in this candidate's closed list.

question.description: At most one question, with the open question's option ids (K-03; S13-28 rule 50). Absent when the message asks nothing.

page_type.description: One page type the step allows; absent for none (architecture 01 line 97; K-03).

thread_reply_to.description: The open question a threaded reply answers, when the reply answers one of several (architecture 07 'Threaded reply').

slotName.description: The record's 16 named slots, the auto-fill slots, the link slots and today and tomorrow (K-03 'The slot vocabulary'). 'hold' is refused since D66, so it is not listed.

formats_id.title: Id
formats_id.description: An opaque id: a non-empty string that code compares as a whole and never parses (CQ-09: 'other ids opaque strings').
